newsitem.title: UK: United News to buy stock photo co FPG Intl.
newsitem.headline: United News to buy stock photo co FPG Intl.

text.p: Britain's United News & Media Plc said on Monday it agreed to buy New York-based stock photography business FPG International for an undisclosed amount.
United News said it would combine FPG, formerly known as the Freelance Photographers Guild, with its Visual Communications Group unit.
"This deal creates the world's largest supplier in a market which has been growing at some 20 percent a year in recent years," the company said in a statement.
The company's shares fell 6.0p to 725.5 by 1240 GMT.
United News estimated the stock photography market at about $1.0 billion a year out of the total photo market of $3.0 billion.
